plugins.name: crbiz-pm
plugins.description: CRBiz PM for Claude Code. PM-as-Configuration-Overlay grammar with reference implementations of the discovery-strategy, tailwind-catalyst-app and zoho-catalyst-app archetypes. Install via marketplace on any surface; slash-command invocation runs in Claude Code CLI on a local folder or a Claude Code remote session against a repo (not currently supported in claude.ai/code Cowork). Bidirectional HTML board with IndexedDB-persistent file access, chip-spawn wrapper with per-chip git worktree allocation, Tie-back protocol, lean PM context. v2.1.5 of the PM-on-CC discipline — a correctness release: splits the Catalyst name collision (two unrelated products share the name) and extends the R4 hard wall to Zoho Catalyst markers, which it did not previously guard; splits pm-memory into per-user and cited-discipline classes with a privacy gate; adds the diamond-cohort spawn primitive and /pm-lint I12 (cohort size). Also carries v2.1.4's discipline hardening (U10 no-exploratory-writes, rule-conflict hard stop, unverified-claims handoff section). 39 skills + 6 agents + SessionStart hook + 2 PreToolUse hooks (git-stage-guard + worktree-visibility-guard); /pm-lint runs 21 checks.

plugins.name: pm-board-keeper
plugins.description: DEPRECATED in favour of crbiz-pm v2.0 (which lifts the pm-board skill + pm-board-keeper agent + 6 pm-board-* commands). Stand up and maintain a single-file HTML PM dashboard (docs/board.html) for chip-spawn workflows.
